title: Chat.activeCallId set-by mechanism unspecified
description: Chat spec line 530-531 says 'the server sets this' but doesn't define HOW the VTC subsystem signals the Chat subsystem to update activeCallId. Is it a DB trigger? In-process call? Cross-service event? The mechanics of this cross-capability side effect are completely unspecified. Implementers with separate Chat and VTC services have no guidance.
